title: Reopen the Valewood market
summary: The market square has stood empty since the stalls were taken down. The council wants frames from a Smith, opening stock from the Farmers and Vintners, lights from a Technician, and lanterns from anybody. Five contributions put the stalls back up.
flavour_after: The stalls are back up by the centre. The council did it with whoever brought them the frames and the stock.
